note: USACE John Redmond Reservoir campground on the upstream side of the dam: a wooded north loop and an open south loop above the boat ramps, with a playground and day-use shelters between. --Claude
summary: rec.gov 233481: 20 electric (30 A + water) + 1 tent/car site, shelters excluded; $19 (the $15 site takes no RV, so base 19, was 15-19); 40-99 ft, 6 pull-throughs; showers/flush/vault/dump; season Apr 1-Oct 30 (rate season + calendar); 14 in 30. Lakeview stands (south loop). Pin is in the empty field between loops -> move.
flags: WATERFRONT: stored LAKEVIEW stands. On Esri/NAIP with the catalog coordinates, the south loop (11-21, ~38.2457,-95.7557) sits 60-90 m from the reservoir across the park road and an open grass strip with scattered trees - a clear lake view but not on-water (road between). The north loop (1-10) is in trees 300+ m from the water with no view. No catalog 'Proximity to Water' tags.

PIN 38.2488,-95.7562 is in the open field between the loops, ~330 m from the south loop and ~250-480 m from the north loop's sites. Propose 38.2457,-95.7557 (the south loop: 11 of the 21 sites and the lakeview ones).
SPLIT: no - the two loops are ~600-800 m apart on the same park road and one rec.gov facility.
FEES: base raised 15 -> 19 because the $15 site (14) permits only tents/vehicles/cars on recreation.gov, so it is not a site a 23-ft motorhome fits.

MAX RIG: 99 ft is the catalog's Driveway Length on sites 1, 3, 4 and 11 (Site Length there 35-70); the per-equipment max lengths are blank (0). The stored 60 came from note prose. A placeholder-looking 99 is possible; the next longest are 90 (8, 9, 10, 12).
SEASON: written Apr 1-Oct 30 from the rate season and the calendar; no page states the season in words. Flush toilets, showers and drinking water are listed as seasonal.
PHONE 620-364-8613 confirmed (rec.gov facility phone). Website (rec.gov) as stored.
SAND: none - gravel sites; the exposed shore below the south loop is the reservoir's drawdown apron, not camping.
